name: knowledge-prominence-v3
supersedes: knowledge-prominence-v2 (148 pairs, below the FLOOR floor; its builder was not recorded)
design: Both classes REAL. label 0 = mean daily en.wikipedia user pageviews >= HIGH; label 1 = <= LOW, from the SAME seed category. Pairs matched exactly on surface form (see provenance.pairing).
label_source: en.wikipedia pageviews (agent=user), external to any model

fetch.pageviews_api: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php prop=pageviews pvipdays=60 (daily user views, all access)
fetch.sampling: form-eligible titles per seed category; seeded random sample of at most 6000 (random.Random(20261027), seeds in SEEDS order)

firm: Companies listed on the New York Stock Exchange

provenance.membership: direct article members only (namespace 0, gcmtype=page); no subcategory traversal

pageview_window.statistic: mean daily user views over every day of the window (MediaWiki prop=pageviews); a null day counts as 0; a title whose response lacks any window date is excluded

form_filter.excluded: titles starting 'List of'; names appearing under two seed categories

exact: per-word capitalisation shape (A=Initial, a=lower, U=ALLCAPS, M=mixed)
function words and their positions (list below)
pairing.order: seeded shuffle of both pools, then each high item takes the first unused matching low item
pairing.cap: at most 10000 pairs per domain, a seeded random subset
